name: Necromancy (Cenotaph Path) — Intermediate — Tread Upon the Grave

system.description: The Necromancer spends a Willpower Trait and makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty set by the Storyteller/Narrator) to sense the strength of the Shroud in her immediate surroundings, learning whether the location is highly attuned to the Shadowlands, average, or far removed from the realm of death. Usable only once per location per game session. Failure reveals nothing.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
